subject: Decide MIN_PERIODS threshold with stated basis
description: DONE 2026-08-18 (DEC-MINPERIODS). MIN_PERIODS = MAX_LAG + HORIZON + 1 = 15, derived from the feature specification rather than chosen: a brand with fewer months yields zero usable training rows. Costs 0.0% of training rows across all four categories; the previous hardcoded 40 cost 20.5/16.8/40.8/30.2% (CSD/Danskvand/Energidrikke/RTD). Rejected lag-3 (+43% rows) because EDA 3.16 measures lag 12 significant across the majority of leading brands. Written up in 05_thesis_writing/notes sec.11. Evidence: P0038 F47, F48.
